Title: [DECK] In Death and Undeath You Belong To Me

Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
Deck Name : In Death And Undeath You Belong To Me
Author : Juggernaut1981
Description :
Matthias + Agaitas & Others
Steal prey minions, find a way to burn them, Daemonic Possession
them...

Crypt (12 vampires) Capacity min: 4 max: 7 average: 5.91667

3x Agaitas, The Schol 6 AUS NEC for Harbinger:2
2x Mina Grotius 6 FOR NEC cel Harbinger:3
2x Maldavis 4 AUS for pre Caitiff:3
1x Billy 5 AUS dom for !Ventrue:2

4x Daemonic Possession
8x Spirit Marionette

2x Daring the Dawn
4x Dawn Operation
4x Day Operation

>
> 4x Matthias               7  AUS FOR OBE nec   Salubri:2
> 3x Agaitas, The Schol     6  AUS NEC for       Harbinger:2
> 2x Mina Grotius           6  FOR NEC cel       Harbinger:3
> 2x Maldavis               4  AUS for pre       Caitiff:3
> 1x Billy                  5  AUS dom for       !Ventrue:2
>

Crypt looks solid.

> Library (90 cards)
> ------------------------------------------------------------
>
> Action (16)
>   4x Anima Gathering

I dunno about the Anima Gatherings. You don't have any cards you need
to block a stealthy D action coming at. They do let you take an
otherwise worthless Demonic Possessed vampire with aus/AUS and turn
him into something useful. Still, I don't think you need more than 2.

>   4x Daemonic Possession

I'd increase these. Since they are timing dependent you'll want to
make sure you are drawing them when you need them.

>   8x Spirit Marionette
>
> Action Modifier (20)
>   4x Call of the Hungry Dead
>   2x Daring the Dawn
>   4x Dawn Operation
>   4x Day Operation

Between Daring, Dawn and Day, only Daring the Dawn will enable you to
burn a stolen vamp during a bleed and then only if you can get them to
spend their last blood to get them empty. Were you planning to
diablerize someone that went to torpor? If that is the case you don't
have a good way to survive the blood hunt and using dominate for
Graverobbing would work better than Demonic Possession.

>   6x Freak Drive
>
> Combat (26)
>   8x Anesthetic Touch
>   6x Skin of Night
>   4x Skin of Rock
>   4x Skin of Steel
>   4x Superior Mettle
>

I think you have too much combat here. 16 combat cards is probably
enough. I don't know what your local metagame is like though.

> Master (14)
>   6x Fortitude
>   2x Heidelberg Castle, Germany

I think you need 3-4 Heidelbergs so can take full advantage of Spirit
Marrionetting a vampire and almost sucking them dry before their
mandatory bleed.

>   4x Minion Tap
>   2x Tribute to the Master

I think the Tributes would be better off as more Minion Taps.
Alternatively replace all Minion Tap and Tribute with Blood Doll and
an otherwise worthless Demonic Possessed vamp can hunt for you the
rest of the game.

>
> Reaction (14)
>   6x Telepathic Misdirection
>   8x Wake with Evening's Freshness

If you have them, change to 6x Eyes of Argus and 2x On the Qui Vie. It
won't really matter if your Demonic Possessed vampires don't have AUS
for Eyes untap since they can't play your bounce anyways.

Good luck.

Oh, and prepare to be hated. No one likes their vamps stolen and blown
up. They probably like it even less when you then possess them. :)

Later,
~Rehlow

> Deck Name : In Death And Undeath You Belong To Me

...
> 4x Daemonic Possession

Daemonic Possession
Type: Action
Requires: Necromancy
Cost: 2 blood
[nec] Only usable when a minion controlled by another Methuselah has
been burned since your last turn. Move that minion from his owner's ash
heap to your ready region, put 1 blood or life from the blood bank on
the minion and tap the minion. You now control the minion.
[NEC] As above, but the minion is untapped.

Unfortunately burning them while YOU control them with a spirit
marionette and daring the dawn does not qualify for daemonic
possession's "controlled by *another* methuselah" clause.

Messages.Author: wedge
Messages.Body:
> Unfortunately burning them while YOU control them with a spirit
> marionette and daring the dawn does not qualify for daemonic
> possession's "controlled by *another* methuselah" clause.

[OBE] +1 stealth action. (D) Take control of any ready untapped minion
until the end of the next action. That minion must bleed your prey
unless he or she must hunt.

[for] Vampires cannot block this action. The acting vampire takes 2
aggravated damage (not preventable) after the action resolves.

[for] Only usable at the end of a successful action (after resolving
the action). Untap this vampire.

I am pretty sure these all happen in the same window (after resolving
the action) So, you as the acting Meth can choose the order the
effects take place. Freak Drive > Spirit Marionette >> Daring the
Dawn
So all the Day Operations should be more copies of Daring the Dawn

You really need Precognizant Mobility and a couple of copies of Mylan
Horseed. I doubt you will need many or any Anima Gatherings. As you
will want small caps to be untapping your target minion.

Erciyes Fragments and Crematorium would be useful as well.

Dreams of the sphinx and the barrens can help you set your hand up for
the steal and burn. Or used to clear out your hand if your were temped
to use Agitas special.
